Oil Peppermint has many applications and is an important flavoring ingredient in chewing gum, toothpaste, mouthwash and a wide range of chocolate and other confectionery products. Distilled in the fields, peppermint oil is typically redistilled and tripled distilled to improve its flavor and aroma. Our Oil Peppermint Triple Distilled is very clean and is ideal for use in chocolates and baked goods. This oil is highly concentrated and should be used very sparingly. We recommend that gloves and eye protection be used when handling peppermint or any other essential oils. This Peppermint Triple Distilled FCC Oil is 100% pure peppermint oil and contains no additives or dilutants.
